g.title: Each chat request carries the user's text and a small context: current view, selected email, active filters and ten loaded emails. When the stream finishes, useAIChat applies the tool calls to the store, so every AI action is a visible change in the interface.

Streams a Groq response with openEmail, navigateView, composeEmail and replyToEmail as Zod-typed tools. Each tool only returns an acknowledgement and none can send mail. The system prompt limits the model to email ids in the context.
Receives the chat history plus a compact context: current view, selected email, filters and the ten most recent emails as 100 character snippets. Replies stream back token by token.
Drafts from the assistant arrive here marked as written by the assistant. They go through the same composer and confirmation dialog as hand-written mail, so the user edits, presses Send and confirms.
The only way mail leaves the app. The assistant has no send tool, so a send happens only after the user confirms.
